summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Tom Allen sparred Joe Coburn before a jammed crowd at Coburn's benefit at Mozart Hall, where Coburn landed twice as many blows while Allen, the heavier man, barely exerted himself.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Daily Democrat, Tuesday Morning, April 26, 1870.

facts.fact: Allen sparred Joe Coburn at Coburn's complimentary benefit at Mozart Hall, St. Louis; Coburn was more active and landed about twice as many blows
Allen had a saloon in St. Louis in spring 1870, named as a deposit point in the Seddons-Lafferty match articles

notes: The Seddons-Lafferty match (May 24, $900 stake) is otherwise not about Allen.
